projects.name: Project 1
details: Responsibilities:
• Developed and enhanced ServiceNow GRC/IRM solutions, including Policy and
Compliance Management, Risk Management, Control Management, Issue
Management, Risk Assessments, and Audit Management, to support enterprise
governance and regulatory compliance initiatives.
• Configured risk statements, risk assessment methodologies, risk scoring models, risk
indicators (KRIs), control objectives, control tests, and issue remediation workflows
to improve enterprise risk visibility and compliance monitoring.
• Designed and customized policy lifecycle workflows, policy attestations, compliance
tasks, and automated approval processes to streamline governance activities and
ensure adherence to organizational standards.
• Implemented automated risk assessment questionnaires, risk calculation logic, and
approval workflows using Flow Designer, Business Rules, Script Includes, Client
Scripts, and UI Policies.
• Customized GRC/IRM workspaces, dashboards, reports, and Performance Analytics
to provide real-time visibility into organizational risks, compliance status, control
effectiveness, and remediation progress.
• Developed secure platform functionality using Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI
Actions, Script Includes, Scheduled Jobs, Background Scripts, and Glide API,
following ServiceNow best practices and upgrade-safe development standards.
• Configured users, groups, roles, and Access Control Lists (ACLs) to enforce role- based security and ensure appropriate access to sensitive governance and compliance
data.
• Integrated ServiceNow GRC/IRM with external applications using REST APIs,
Scripted REST APIs, JSON and XML payloads, OAuth 2.0, and Basic
Authentication, enabling seamless exchange of compliance and risk-related information.
• Implemented and enhanced HRSD Risk and Compliance processes by automating HR
case evaluations, employee risk assessments, and governance workflows to improve
regulatory compliance.
• Built advanced Service Catalog Items and Record Producers with dynamic variables,
approvals, SLAs, and automated fulfillment processes to support governance and
operational requests.
• Customized Agent Workspace and CSM Workspace components to improve agent
productivity through configurable layouts, workspaces, and guided processes.
• Managed data migration activities using Import Sets, Transform Maps, Data Sources,
Scheduled Imports, Update Sets, and Scoped Applications, ensuring reliable
deployments across multiple environments.
• Contributed to CMDB health improvements through CI data quality validation,
relationship mapping, Discovery support, and dependency management to enhance
operational visibility.
• Enhanced user experience by customizing Service Portal, developing reusable widgets,
and implementing intuitive self-service interfaces for governance and compliance
processes.
• Performed root cause analysis, debugging, log analysis, and performance tuning to resolve production issues, improve platform stability, and ensure high-quality, upgrade-
safe implementations.
• Collaborated with business stakeholders, compliance teams, risk managers, and cross- functional development teams to gather requirements, design scalable solutions, and
deliver enterprise applications aligned with ITIL and organizational governance
standards.

projects.name: Project 2
details: Responsibilities:
• Developed and customized ServiceNow ITSM modules, including Incident, Problem,
Change, Request, Knowledge Management, and Service Catalog, to automate
business processes and improve service delivery.
• Implemented business requirements using Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script
Includes, UI Policies, UI Actions, Data Policies, Scheduled Jobs, and Background
Scripts, ensuring scalable and upgrade-safe solutions.
• Designed and developed Service Catalog Items, Record Producers, Order Guides,
Variable Sets, catalog client scripts, and approval workflows to streamline request
fulfillment.
• Customized forms, views, related lists, reference qualifiers, and client-side components to enhance usability and improve the overall user experience.
• Developed automation using Flow Designer, including flows, subflows, approvals,
notifications, and event-driven actions to eliminate manual processes and improve
operational efficiency.
• Created reusable server-side logic and custom scripts to automate assignment, SLA
management, notifications, task creation, and business process orchestration.
• Integrated ServiceNow with external applications using REST APIs, Scripted REST
APIs, JSON and XML payload processing, and OAuth/Basic Authentication for secure
data exchange.
• Developed and customized Service Portal components, including widgets, client scripts,
catalog pages, and UI enhancements to improve the self-service experience.
• Built interactive reports, dashboards, and Performance Analytics indicators to provide
insights into incident trends, SLA compliance, service performance, and operational
KPIs.
• Developed data import solutions using Import Sets, Transform Maps, Data Sources,
and Scheduled Imports to automate data migration while maintaining data integrity.
• Contributed to CMDB enhancements by developing scripts for CI updates, relationship
management, and data validation to improve configuration data quality.
• Implemented role-based security using Access Control Lists (ACLs), user criteria, and
role configurations to protect sensitive business data and enforce organizational security
policies.
• Participated in application deployments using Update Sets, Scoped Applications, and
version-controlled development practices, ensuring smooth migration across
development, testing, and production environments.
• Performed troubleshooting, debugging, and root cause analysis using System Logs,
Background Scripts, JavaScript Debugger, and Script Tracer, resolving production
issues and improving platform performance.
• Collaborated with business analysts, solution architects, QA teams, and stakeholders to gather requirements, develop technical solutions, perform unit testing, and deliver high-
quality enhancements aligned with ITIL best practices and ServiceNow development
standards.

projects.name: Project 3
details: Responsibilities:
• Delivered a comprehensive ServiceNow implementation integrating HR Service
Delivery (HRSD), ITSM, and Customer Service Management (CSM) for a global
enterprise client, streamlining employee lifecycle processes and customer support
operations.
• Configured HR Case Management, Knowledge Base, and Employee Service Center
portals, improving onboarding, offboarding, transfers, and access request efficiency
• Automated ITSM processes including Incident, Problem, and Change Management,
integrating with HRSD to ensure seamless ticket handoffs and faster resolution.
• Designed CSM workflows to manage customer inquiries, escalations, and SLA tracking,
providing real-time visibility and unified reporting dashboards.
• Developed custom workflows and Flow Designer flows for HR and IT request
fullfilment, reducing manual intervention by 35% and improving employee and customer
satisfaction.
• Configured email notifications, inbound actions, and service catalog items to automate request capture, Implemented CMDB alignment and CI relationships to
maintain accurate asset and HR data for compliance and audit purposes.
• Built interactive dashboards and Performance Analytics reports, enabling executives
to track SLA compliance, ticket trends, and service health across HR, IT, and Customer
Service channels.
• Administered roles, ACLs, and SSO and LDAP integration for secure access
management, Leveraged JavaScript, Glide API, HTML5, CSS3, and AngularJS for
portal customization and responsive UI design.
• Followed Agile/Scrum methodology using JIRA for sprint planning, backlog
management, and iterative delivery, while conducting peer mentoring, code reviews,
and knowledge transfer sessions to strengthen team capabilities.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor of Engineering (B.E) — HMS institute of Technology, VTU University,
